rationale: After 62 minutes in the trade and reaching a session high of $39.47 (just short of the $39.55 target), upward momentum has stalled and price has slipped below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($39.31). The last five 1-minute candles show a steady bleed of lower highs and lower lows down to $39.28, breaking a key trend support pillar from the original entry thesis. With 75 minutes remaining in the session and the stock giving back roughly 40% of its maximum favorable excursion, closing now locks in the $52.44 gain rather than risking a deeper round-trip back toward entry.
